name: Karnataka GCC Policy 2024-2029 - Innovation and R&D Subsidy
summary: Up to 40% capital support for establishing Centers of Excellence (CoE) and dedicated R&D innovation labs.

name: Karnataka IT Policy - Electricity Duty Exemption
summary: 100% exemption on electricity duty for eligible IT/ITeS units for a period of 5 years.

name: Telangana ICT Policy - Stamp Duty Reimbursement
summary: 100% reimbursement of stamp duty, transfer duty, and registration fees on first transaction lease or purchase of premises.

name: Telangana ICT Policy - Power Tariff Concession
summary: Industrial power tariff concessions and electricity duty exemption for IT/ITeS enterprises.

name: Maharashtra IT/ITeS Policy 2023 - Stamp Duty Exemption
summary: Stamp duty exemption on lease and sale agreements for eligible IT and ITeS units.
sourceName: Government of Maharashtra Directorate of Industries

name: Maharashtra IT/ITeS Policy 2023 - Industrial Power Tariff
summary: Electricity tariff charged at industrial rates rather than commercial rates, plus electricity duty exemption for 10 years in Zone I.
sourceName: Government of Maharashtra Directorate of Industries

name: Tamil Nadu R&D Policy - GCC Payroll Subsidy
summary: Payroll subsidy of 30% in year 1, 20% in year 2, and 10% in year 3 for employees with salary exceeding ₹1 lakh per month.

name: Tamil Nadu Industrial Policy - Electricity Tax Exemption
summary: 100% exemption from electricity tax on power purchased from TANGEDCO for 5 years.

name: Haryana IT & ESDM Policy - Stamp Duty Reimbursement
summary: 100% reimbursement of stamp duty on office lease and purchase agreements upon commencement of commercial operations.

name: Haryana IT Policy - Electricity Duty Exemption
summary: 100% electricity duty exemption for IT and ITeS enterprises for a period of up to 10 years.
